description: This file defines a PHP controller class 'AOW_WorkFlowController' extending 'SugarController' for managing workflow-related actions within the SuiteCRM system. It handles AJAX requests for fetching module fields, relationships, operators, actions, and other dynamic UI components related to workflows.

classes.name: AOW_WorkFlowController
classes.description: Controller class managing AJAX parts of the workflow module, extending other base classes, providing multiple protected methods to handle specific AJAX actions with parameters from $_REQUEST.

methods.name: action_getModuleFields
methods.description: Responds with HTML options for fields of a given module, optionally based on a related field and view.

methods.name: action_getRelatedModule
methods.description: Outputs the name of the related module for a given module and relation field.

methods.name: action_getModuleRelationships
methods.description: Outputs module relationship data for a given module.

methods.name: action_getModuleOperatorField
methods.description: Generates and outputs a dropdown of operators applicable to a field based on its type.

methods.name: action_getFieldTypeOptions
methods.description: Outputs options for field data types based on module field definition.

methods.name: action_getActionFieldTypeOptions
methods.description: Outputs options for action field types based on module field definition.

methods.name: action_getModuleFieldType
methods.description: Outputs input elements or dropdowns for selecting module field types or parameters.

methods.name: action_getModuleFieldTypeSet
methods.description: Outputs dropdown for setting module field types.

methods.name: action_getModuleField
methods.description: Outputs a form element for a specific module field.

methods.name: action_getRelFieldTypeSet
methods.description: Outputs form elements for related module field types.

methods.name: action_getRelActionFieldTypeOptions
methods.description: Outputs a dropdown of related action types based on module and relation.

methods.name: action_getAction
methods.description: Dynamically loads and executes a specific action class based on request parameters.

methods.name: action_getEmailField
methods.description: Outputs email-related form inputs based on the email field type.

methods.name: action_testFlow
methods.description: Runs a test workflow execution and outputs success message.
